query: SELECT data, CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) as cat9 FROM faturamentos WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND data LIKE '2026-07%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING(data, 9, 2) AS UNSIGNED) <= 15 ORDER BY data;
